title: An Interpretable Memory Decision Controller for LLM Agents Based on Three-Signal Complementarity: Decoupling Confidence and Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2609.22043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory systems for large language models have focused predominantly on efficient retrieval, whereas the decision of whether retrieved memories should be trusted has received comparatively little attention. When the memory store contains conflicting positions, standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) blindly injects memories and amplifies hallucinations: in models susceptible to memory injection, the RAG hallucination rate under conflicting memories is markedly higher than that of a memory-free baseline. translated_title: 基于三信号互补性的可解释大语言模型智能体记忆决策控制器：置信度与一致性的解耦
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.22043v1 公告类型：new 摘要：面向大语言模型的记忆系统研究主要集中于高效检索，而检索到的记忆是否应当被信任这一决策问题却鲜少受到关注。当记忆库中存在相互矛盾的立场时，标准的检索增强生成（RAG）会盲目注入记忆并放大幻觉：在易受记忆注入影响的模型中，矛盾记忆条件下RAG的幻觉率显著高于无记忆基线。受前额叶皮层记忆信号机制的启发，我们提出了记忆决策层（MDL），这是一个位于检索与生成阶段之间的零参数记忆决策控制器。其核心是一个三信号互补编码器，通过基于QR分解的正交子空间投影与元工作记忆信号，将相关性、可靠性和任务风险融合为一种可解释的决策表示，
tldr: 提出零参数的记忆决策层（MDL），通过融合相关性、可靠性与任务风险的三信号互补可解释编码器，判断检索记忆是否可信，从而避免RAG在矛盾记忆下放大幻觉。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a zero-parameter Memory Decision Layer (MDL) with an interpretable three-signal complementary encoder that fuses relevance, reliability, and task risk to decide whether retrieved memories should be trusted, preventing RAG from amplifying hallucinations under conflicting memories.
